purpose: Fail-closed real staging/shadow outage-drill gate for governed provider failover.
required_inputs: preregistered failover plan + exact SHA256 + independent pre-drill timestamp anchor
secondary rights/schema/freshness PASS evidence available before switch
human approval evidence after primary failure detection and before switch
mandatory_controls: human approval for one staging/shadow drill
switch only after outage is observed
closure_rule: Synthetic PASS validates the auditor only. H-01 remains OPEN until a real staging/shadow outage drill passes with independent evidence and human approval.
